Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert failed to conclusively determine the fruits served on the SS Ile de France's October 1949 breakfast menu due to incomplete information gathering. Although it correctly identified that the menu mentioned “Fruit” and “Pamplemousse Juice,” the agent drew an incorrect conclusion that none of the fruits depicted in the painting were served. The reasoning excluded the possibility that watermelon, pears, or lemons could have been included in the unspecified "Fruit" category, which was an oversight. This error could have been mitigated by seeking additional clarification or corroboration on what was encompassed in the "Fruit" category before jumping to conclusions.
